Title: Timeout transfer not set to Pending
Description: When the real-time rail does not acknowledge a transfer within 30 seconds, the transfer remains in 'Processing' instead of transitioning to 'Pending', and the customer is not notified.
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Configure the rail simulator to not respond; 2) Submit an off-us transfer; 3) Wait 60 seconds; 4) Observe the status
Resolution: Pending fix; timeout handler to transition status and trigger notification

Title: Personal daily limit not enforced
Description: A customer-configured personal daily limit is saved but is not applied during transfer validation; transfers above the personal limit are processed successfully.
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Set a personal daily limit of 2,000.00; 2) Attempt a 3,000.00 transfer in the same day; 3) Observe that the transfer is processed
Resolution: Pending fix; transfer validation must consider the effective limit

Title: Fraud high-risk profile cannot be activated in UAT
Description: The fraud engine UAT instance does not allow enabling the high-risk profile, which blocks execution of the high-risk hold scenario.
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open the fraud engine UAT settings; 2) Attempt to enable the high-risk profile; 3) Profile is not selectable
Resolution: Configuration access requested; profile to be enabled for retest

Title: Push notification not delivered on success
Description: For a successful transfer, the email notification is received but the push notification is not delivered to the registered device.
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Complete a successful transfer; 2) Check the registered device for a push notification; 3) Only the email is received
Resolution: Pending fix; notification service push channel under investigation

Title: Receipt shows wrong currency and misses reference
Description: The downloadable transfer receipt displays the amount with the wrong currency symbol and omits the transfer reference.
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open transfer history; 2) Download a receipt; 3) Inspect the currency symbol and reference

Title: Incorrect insufficient-balance error message
Description: When a transfer is rejected for insufficient balance, the message shown is 'Funds unavailable' instead of the agreed copy 'Insufficient available balance'.
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Set available balance to 100.00; 2) Attempt a 150.00 transfer; 3) Read the error message
Resolution: Pending fix; error catalogue to be updated
